phases.name: K3: kernel services
phases.goal: Everything else modules rely on, in the order the site's modules use it.
phases.gate: Tests for each service; an event delivered once to a handler safe to run twice; a job surviving a worker restart.

items.name: Email: templates, SMTP first, Resend where SMTP is blocked
The kernel's own mails as templates a site can reword
Jobs: the Postgres queue, the scheduler, mail retries
Events: emitted in the caller's transaction, delivered as jobs, dead letters
Audit: one append-only log for every module, auth's widened
Notifications, with per-person preferences and one-click unsubscribe
Moderation: reports, the staff queue, filters and actions
Public rendering: head tags, server copy, sitemap, robots, llms.txt
